headline: Αablepes mikres kinesies stin agora synallagmatos eno oi eidiseis einai periorismenes.

pairs.reason: To zevgos ypochorise elafros kata 0.05% apo to kleisimo tis EKT stis 4 Noemvriou 2026. Oi diathesimes eidiseis tis teleutias periodou den parechoun kapoion sygekrimeno kai safi oikonomiko odigo pou na erkynei tin kinisi auti.

To zevgos emeine sxedon atalantefto, simeionontas metavoli +0.02%. Den yparchoun prosfates eidiseis pou na dikologoun kapoia axiosi stin poreia tou, pera apo tin anamesa anamesa sto RTGS CHAPS Industry Forum tis Trapezas tis Anglias.
To zevgos katagrafe ptyosi kata 0.19% se schesi me to proigoumeno kleisimo tis EKT. Oi parovles eidiseis den periechoun kapoia sygkekrimeni eidisi i stoicheio pou na eksigei autin tin ypochorisi.
